newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks climb ahead of Ibex futures expiry.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks climb ahead of Ibex futures expiry.

text.p: MADRID, June 20 (Reuter) 0915 GMT - Madrid stocks climbed in early trade amid high volume on Friday ahead of the expiry of the June Ibex futures contract and as domestic funds returned to the market, dealers said. * General index rises 3.42 points, 0.59 percent, to 585.94. * Ibex-35 index up 45.09 points, 0.68 percent, to 6,719.86. * Turnover reaches 42 billion pesetas in first 20 minutes. Some 25 billion of this related to a block trade by Merrill Lynch.
"The market is still excited after the Telepizza placement on Thursday and the market is also discounting further falls in interest rates," one dealer said.
At home, dealers said all eyes were on Tuesday's Bank of Spain repo auction. Analysts are divided on whether the central bank will cut the key rate another 25 basis points.
Among individual stocks, Telepizza rose 10 pesetas to 8,170 after Thursday's announcement that a unit of BBV had sold 9.55 percent of Telepizza for 8,000 pesetas a share.
Telefonica rose 45 pesetas, 1.04 percent, to 4,375, while Santander gained 45 pesetas to 4,495.
Earlier, Santander declined to comment on newspaper reports that it had sold one percent of Telefonica.
